_status: provisional (unit 1.3). Every value here was chosen against a measurement taken on 2026-09-18, and each note says which.
_rpc_endpoints_note: Credential names, in failover order; the URLs themselves are secrets in .env. There is ONE mainnet endpoint, the public robinhood.com RPC, and it carries no archive data (research/agent-os.md §8). The adapter's failover advances on a hang as well as a rejection, but with one entry it has nowhere to go, so in practice this is still timeout plus fail loudly (PLAN §13). RPC_4663_TESTNET is chain 46630 and is never a failover for 4663.
_block_tag_note: The block a snapshot pins to. Every read after that addresses the block by hash (EIP-1898, measured working), so a reorg fails with 'header not found' rather than reading another block. 'safe' ran ~11 min behind latest and 'finalized' ~17 min, both measured.
_request_timeout_note: A whole-request deadline, not just a socket timeout: a hang advances to the next attempt. Measured reads take 140-300 ms; a 215-read Multicall3 took ~290 ms.
_backoff_note: Doubles per retry: 2, 4 s. The RPC's 429 is a JSON-RPC error via Cloudflare with NO Retry-After, so there is no server hint to honour (measured).
_min_request_interval_note: A batch of 100 eth_calls drew an immediate 429; single Multicall3 calls one second apart never did (measured).
_multicall_note: Multicall3 is deployed on 4663 (3,808 bytes of code). One aggregate3 call of 215 getRoundData reads was accepted where a JSON-RPC batch of 100 was refused (measured).
_series_note: Seven days of Chainlink rounds up to the pinned block. Rounds per day run from ~1.5 (SPY) to ~80 (SNDK), so the window is by time with a round cap; hitting the cap makes the series visibly short. History is readable at a recent block without archive: 645 of 645 AAPL rounds (measured).
_scale_break_note: Consecutive answers differing by this factor or more are a scale break, not a price move. 32 of 37 mapped feeds began life reporting answers ~1e8 larger than their 8 decimals (measured); a series stops at the break and says so.
_user_agent_note: The 4663 RPC returns 403 without a User-Agent, and that 403 looks like an auth failure (probe 0.3).
